lessons.title: Calculus and gradients
lessons.detail: Derivatives, partial derivatives, chain rule, Jacobians and optimization.

lessons.title: Probability and statistics
lessons.detail: Random variables, distributions, Bayes, expectation, variance and estimation.

curriculum.name: Classical Machine Learning
curriculum.description: Learn the modelling workflow using real datasets and sound evaluation.

lessons.title: Data investigation and feature engineering
lessons.detail: Data quality, leakage, missing values, encoding, scaling and feature reasoning.

lessons.title: Supervised learning
lessons.detail: Linear and logistic regression, trees, ensembles and model evaluation.

lessons.title: Unsupervised learning and dimensionality reduction
lessons.detail: Clustering, PCA and representation of high-dimensional data.

curriculum.name: Deep Learning & PyTorch
curriculum.description: Understand neural networks before moving into transformer internals.

lessons.title: Tensors and PyTorch workflow
lessons.detail: Tensor creation, shapes, broadcasting, matrix multiplication, autograd and datasets.

lessons.title: Neural networks from scratch
lessons.detail: Neurons, layers, loss functions, backpropagation, optimizers and training loops.

lessons.title: CNNs and practical deep learning
lessons.detail: Convolutions, transfer learning, regularization and experiment tracking.

lessons.title: Attention and transformers
lessons.detail: Attention, self-attention, positional information and a small GPT implementation.

curriculum.name: Software Engineering & MLOps
curriculum.description: Turn experiments into testable, deployable software.

lessons.title: Python software engineering
lessons.detail: OOP when useful, project structure, typing, tests, logging and packaging.

lessons.title: APIs, FastAPI and Docker
lessons.detail: Build inference APIs, validate inputs, containerize and test services.

lessons.title: MLflow, CI/CD and monitoring
lessons.detail: Track experiments, version data, automate checks and monitor model services.

lessons.title: Cloud deployment foundations
lessons.detail: Deploy a small service, understand object storage, compute, networking and costs.

curriculum.name: Systems & Distributed Computing
curriculum.description: Learn the infrastructure ideas behind scalable services and ML platforms.

lessons.title: Operating systems and networking
lessons.detail: Processes, memory, concurrency, HTTP, TCP, latency and resource limits.

lessons.title: Databases, caching and queues
lessons.detail: Indexes, transactions, cache policies, task queues, streams and backpressure.

lessons.title: Distributed systems foundations
lessons.detail: Replication, consistency, partitioning, consensus, failure and observability.

lessons.title: System design for ML services
lessons.detail: Design an ML-backed service with SLOs, capacity estimates and failure handling.

curriculum.name: Inference Engineering & AI Infrastructure
curriculum.description: Your primary specialization: measure, optimize and operate model inference.

lessons.title: Run and inspect your first open LLM
lessons.detail: Load a small model, tokenize prompts, generate output and observe GPU memory.

lessons.title: Prefill, decode and KV cache
lessons.detail: Understand token generation, KV memory, context length and concurrency limits.

lessons.title: Benchmark inference correctly
lessons.detail: Measure TTFT, TPOT, throughput, tail latency, goodput and reproducibility.

lessons.title: Serving engines and continuous batching
lessons.detail: Compare a basic PyTorch server with vLLM; study scheduling and batching.

lessons.title: Quantization, profiling and optimization
lessons.detail: Study precision, memory bandwidth, profiling and quality/performance tradeoffs.

lessons.title: Production inference capstone
lessons.detail: Build, benchmark, monitor and document a cost-aware inference service.
